description_en: Ayla's letter speaks of simplicity, calmness, and quiet warmth. The Ayla top reflects this through its clean minimal front and bright batik side panels, adding soft contrast and an effortless glow without feeling overwhelming.
note_en: Finished with a discreet button at the back of the neck for easy wear.
title: Ayla Top
description_id: Surat Ayla berbicara tentang kesederhanaan, ketenangan, dan kehangatan yang tenang. Atasan Ayla mencerminkan hal ini melalui bagian depan yang bersih dan minimal serta panel batik cerah di sisi, menambahkan kontras lembut dan cahaya tanpa usaha tanpa terasa berlebihan.
